name: grokipedia
title: Grokipedia
description: A Raycast extension that lets you quickly search Grokipedia for concise knowledge and reference results.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: search-grokipedia
commands.title: Search Grokipedia
commands.description: Search Grokipedia for articles and reference entries

tools.name: get-stats
tools.title: Get Grokipedia Stats
tools.description: Fetches Grokipedia site statistics including total pages, views, and index size

tools.name: search-typeahead
tools.title: Search Typeahead
tools.description: Gets typeahead/autocomplete suggestions for a search query

tools.name: full-text-search
tools.title: Full-Text Search
tools.description: Performs a full-text search across Grokipedia articles

tools.name: get-page
tools.title: Get Page
tools.description: Fetches a specific Grokipedia page by its slug with full content and metadata

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
